# netbox_vrf (Data Source)

A VRF (ipam.vrf).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/ipam/#virtual-routing-and-forwarding-vrf):

> A VRF object in NetBox represents a virtual routing and forwarding (VRF) domain. Each VRF is essentially a separate routing table. VRFs are commonly used to isolate customers or organizations from one another within a network, or to route overlapping address space (e.g. multiple instances of the 10.0.0.0/8 space). Each VRF may be assigned to a specific tenant to aid in organizing the available IP space by customer or internal user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vrf" "test" {
  name = "test-vrf"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `rd` (String) Route distinguisher (unique).
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `tenant_group_id` (Number) Id of the tenant group.
- `tenant_group_slug` (String) Slug of the tenant group.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `tenant_slug` (String) Slug of the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `enforce_unique` (Boolean) Prevent duplicate prefixes/IP addresses within this VRF.
- `export_targets` (Set of Number) Ids of exported route targets.
- `import_targets` (Set of Number) Ids of imported route targets.
- `ip_address_count` (Number) Number of IP addresses in the VRF.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `prefix_count` (Number) Number of prefixes in the VRF.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
